_comment: Approximate July-1914 borders reconstructed from Natural Earth (public domain) modern countries and first-level regions. Approximate (hand-drawn cut lines or whole modern units standing in for historic ones): German-Russian border in western Poland (Prosna line, Kujawy, Dobrzyn land, Zaglebie); Austrian-Russian line north of Krakow; Prussian/Austrian Silesia split; Danish North Schleswig; Eupen-Malmedy; Memel territory; Bukovina (northern Suceava, Chernivtsi minus Khotyn); northern Ternopil (Kremenets) to Russia; Transylvania/Banat/Crisana/Maramures as whole modern counties; Vojvodina districts plus Zemun side of Belgrade; Trentino-Alto Adige and Trieste/Gorizia provinces (Cortina, Tarvisio etc. ignored); Bay of Kotor as Herceg Novi/Kotor/Tivat/Budva; Kosovo Pec/Istok/Klina/Decani/Gjakova districts to Montenegro; all of North Macedonia to Serbia (Strumica, Bulgarian 1913-19, ignored); Western Thrace east of a drawn Nestos line; Dodecanese shown as Italian-occupied; Cyprus with UK; Algeria/Tunisia with France; northern Morocco with Spain; Kars/Ardahan/Artvin/Igdir with Russia; Zuiderzee polders removed; upper Neman course hand-traced; modern reservoirs not drawn, natural lakes from Natural Earth.
